title: Whale in a little scarf
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id='body' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0' stop-color='#5db8e8'/>
      <stop offset='1' stop-color='#3a80c0'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='belly' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0' stop-color='#cfe9f7'/>
      <stop offset='1' stop-color='#a8d4ee'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- tail flukes -->
  <path d='M12 48 Q4 38 2 30 Q10 33 16 40 Q13 44 12 48 Z' fill='#2f6fa8'/>
  <path d='M12 48 Q5 58 3 66 Q10 62 16 54 Q13 51 12 48 Z' fill='#2f6fa8'/>

  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='52' cy='52' rx='42' ry='26' fill='url(#body)'/>

  <!-- belly -->
  <path d='M18 58 Q50 84 86 58 Q70 74 50 74 Q30 74 18 58 Z' fill='url(#belly)'/>

  <!-- head hump highlight -->
  <path d='M60 32 Q80 32 88 46 Q74 38 60 40 Z' fill='#8fd2f2' opacity='0.7'/>

  <!-- eye -->
  <circle cx='72' cy='45' r='5' fill='#173a5e'/>
  <circle cx='73.8' cy='43.2' r='1.8' fill='#ffffff'/>

  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M78 54 Q82 60 88 58' stroke='#173a5e' stroke-width='2.2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- blush -->
  <ellipse cx='76' cy='55' rx='4' ry='2.4' fill='#f290b0' opacity='0.75'/>

  <!-- spout -->
  <path d='M46 27 Q43 16 38 12 Q46 13 50 22 Q50 14 48 8 Q54 14 54 24 Z' fill='#a8dcf5'/>
  <circle cx='36' cy='9' r='2.4' fill='#cbeaf8'/>
  <circle cx='52' cy='5' r='2' fill='#cbeaf8'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='12' r='1.8' fill='#cbeaf8'/>

  <!-- scarf band -->
  <path d='M38 66 Q48 74 60 78 Q50 66 46 60 Q42 62 38 66 Z' fill='#e8443c'/>
  <path d='M40 67 Q46 71 52 74' stroke='#ff8a66' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round' opacity='0.9'/>

  <!-- scarf knot and tail -->
  <path d='M46 62 Q40 70 36 80 Q42 76 48 68 Q47 65 46 62 Z' fill='#c93230'/>
  <path d='M44 64 Q38 74 34 84' stroke='#ff8a66' stroke-width='2.4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round' opacity='0.9'/>

  <!-- fin -->
  <path d='M50 70 Q56 82 64 86 Q60 74 56 68 Z' fill='#2f6fa8'/>
</svg>
